A '''[[Defel/Legends|Defel]]''' worked as a '''[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]''' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He wore a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] over his right shoulder and [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] to protect his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from all other forms of light other than [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]].
